newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Casino Data EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Casino Data EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Rodman & Renshaw reduced the earnings estimate for Casino Data Systems to loss $0.14 per share from profit $0.18 for the fourth quarter, and to profit $0.13 from profit $1.03 for the 1997 year.
-- cited management acknowledgement "that troubles do in fact exist" with core wide area progressive and machine sale areas.

-- "We have no confidence at this juncture as to management's ability to perform at a level above what we are currently assuming, given their relative lack of credibility both with us, and in our view, with the rest of the investment community," analyst Daniel Davila wrote in a research note.
-- company makes gaming industry slot accounting and management information systems.
